debug.command: xcodebuild -project Shelf.xcodeproj -scheme Shelf -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -derivedDataPath build build

release.command: xcodebuild -project Shelf.xcodeproj -scheme Shelf -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath build/App.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/App.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist "$MOBAI_EXPORT_OPTIONS" -exportPath build/ipa -allowProvisioningUpdates
